The '''toothspike raptor''' was a deadly predator native to [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]]. It inspired the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] in the aesthetic design of their [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]].
